title: VC vs bootstrapped startups: the emotional curve of each path
summary: A short emoji-based essay contrasting the emotional trajectories of VC-funded and bootstrapped startups. VC startups start with a rush of money and euphoria that ends in a crash, while bootstrapped startups start with doubt and struggle before ending in sustained happiness.

principles.text: VC-funded startups front-load the reward (money and excitement) and often end in a painful crash.
Bootstrapped startups back-load the reward: early doubt and struggle, then profit and lasting happiness.
Building startups without funding is a viable path worth pursuing.
principles.quote: I wrote a book called MAKE about building startups without funding.
